context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Insights overhaul fully tested. Key API details: (1) GET /api/intelligence/money-pattern returns personality, tagline, spendingDNA (needs/wants/savings/emi %), traits, strengths (max 4), blindSpots (max 4), topExpenseCategories, metrics. (2) GET /api/intelligence/survival-clock returns stage (1-20), phase (Critical/Stabilizing/Control/Growth/Power), phaseNum (1-5), totalStages (20), visibleStages (~10 around current), fundBreakdown with liquid/semiLiquid/illiquid buckets + 3 buffer numbers (liquidBuffer, extendedBuffer=Liquid+60%SemiLiquid, netWorth). (3) GET /api/gamification/profile returns 100 achievements with tier and category fields. (4) POST /api/gamification/process awards new badges from 100-badge pool. Frontend widgets: stage-journey, survival-stages-widget, emergency-runway, money-pattern-widget, financial-score, badges-widget (with filter tabs badge-filter-all, badge-filter-survival, etc.), challenges-widget. Fixed XP display bug (changed data.xp to data.currentXP).
